There's an Auto-Foreman at Blackwater Mine waiting for someone to report for duty at the Uranium Extractor facility.

There's an Auto-Foreman at Blackwater Mine waiting for someone to report for duty at the Uranium Extractor Terminal. If someone can get the extraction system running, it could be a great source of valuable nuclear material.

The extractors pulled up and processed Uranium into something usable.
Sounds like a local mine is on the verge of reopening. I wonder what might be inside?
The mine's open, but we've only got a short amount of time to pilfer its minerals. The broadcast also suggested we might be able to repair the local Auto-Miners, maybe get them working for us.
The roof on this place is about to go! We need to get out of here fast!
I came across a small shack in the Mire. I should investigate it and see if I can find anything useful.

I found a terminal in a shack that belonged to a woman named Shelby O'Rourke. Shelby had a series of sensors set up at various locations to try and prove that cryptids exist. I should examine a few of the sites that are displaying alerts to see what's there.
One of the locations had an actual cryptid! I should kill it to bring back a tissue sample to Shelby's homemade lab.
Now that I've killed the cryptid, I should be able to extract a tissue sample.
Now that I've killed the cryptid and extracted a sample, I can take it back to Shelby's homemade lab in her shack and see what sort of results I can get.

I found a huge teapot. I wonder if there's anyone else around.
I need to find some honey if I want to try out this special tea.
Once I have enough honey, I should get back to Sweetwater.
Sweetwater seemed happy. Now I get to enjoy some tea.

The Giant Teapot has refilled the boilers and is ready to begin the steeping process.

This better be really great tea! These creatures are angry.

We need to find the robot waiters and bring them back to work. They're on break, somewhere on the grounds.
The special decorative place settings and floral centerpieces have been misplaced. We have to find them and set the tables before the gala begin, while keeping out any unwanted guests.
We've finished setting up early. Now we just need to guard against any uninvited guests until the Halloween Gala begins.
There's something screaming in the barn...do I dare go and see what it is?

The Brotherhood of Steel was looking for a way to identify the Scorchbeasts' weaknesses. It involved Mission 099-01. I need to find more information about that mission.
Mission 099-01 involves going to Vault-Tec University and wiring up one of their Automated Research Labs to find the weaknesses of the Scorchbeasts.

With the Automated Research Lab fully powered, now I might be able to find out how to conduct research on the Scorchbeasts.

Sounds like we need to clear out the creatures that have taken over this work site. Time to lock and load.

That didn't go well.

I need to find the "Chow Line".

I found a pack of abandoned Brahmin on the road. The out-of-commission Mr. Farmhand that was in charge of them has a Shepherd's Crook and some instructions on how to herd them. Using the power of the Crook, I could get these Brahmin home.

Upon arrival at the farm, we were ambushed by none other than the fabled Sheepsquatch - and it's hungry for Brahmin! As the interim farmhand, it's my responsbility to take down this ferocious cryptid and keep the Brahmin safe.
Looks like there's some kind of party going on. Apparently I need to check in with the Master of Ceremonies. Sounds fun!
The Master of Ceremonies says there's going to be a parade but the marchers haven't shown up yet. I need to go find them.
The parade has started and all of the protectrons are wearing their Fasnacht masks now.
The parade was attacked by huge toads, there were tongues flying everywhere.
The parade was attacked again, this time by suiciding super mutants with bombs!
We managed to finish the parade but it wasn't easy. Now we just need to burn up Old Man Winter.
The Arktos Pharma Biome Lab is ready to run an experiment. I can initialize it at the mainframe terminal just below the lobby.
I've been instructed to fill the feeding troughs in each of the three habitats with something appropriately tasty. The more full the troughs, the stronger the creatures they will attract.

A creature has been attracted to each habitat - and they're friendly! Unfortunately, the other creatures in the chasm are not. In order to keep the experiment running, I must defend my new friends from these predators.
I should investigate this Census Taker robot.
A Census Taker robot has apparently been counting non-humans. It needs to fix the count by killing the things it previously counted. I'll go along for the ride.
I should investigate the situation at the RoboCo Research Center.
I need to recall the AWOL military robots using the beacon in the back of the truck.
The Sergeant Gutsy has powered down to conserve energy. I'll now need to deal with the waves of returning military robots who are dangerous and hostile.
Davie's kickball was knocked outside of Foundation's walls, and he needs someone who can go get it for him.
I found Davie's kickball outside of the walls of Foundation. He'll doubtless be happy to get it back.
His mother, Elsie, might want to know about this. It might get him in trouble though.

I agreed to help Davenport, the Overseer's assistant, by taking reconnaissance photos of targets around the Foundation settlement.
I have to go see Ward at Foundation.
Ward has asked me to recover some missing equipment.
I let the thief keep the equipment. For a price of course.

I should stay near the hunting grounds and defeat any "Prime" creatures I encounter.

The former Raider has been dealt with. Time to report back to Rocksy.
I should speak to Wren and see if she has any jobs for me.
Wren asked me to find radio vacuum tubes for her communications system. She marked the location I can find them on my map.

I've retrieved all the radio vacuum tubes that Wren wanted. I need to find her back at the Crater to turn them in.
A rowdy Eyebot called JES-2R is leading a crew of mischief-makers to wreak havoc on the Whitespring Resort. I should call upon my most wicked instincts for the occasion... and bring a good disguise!
A group of scavengers has set up camp inside Emmett Mountain Disposal Site. I wonder what they're up to? Maybe I should speak to their leader and find out.
I've agreed to help the scavengers with their operation. Their leader, Marion, is explaining the situation now.
The scavengers' operation is underway! We need to mine irradiated ore from tunnels filled with deadly radiation, and guard the base camp from ghoul attack. So far we haven't met our quota, though.

The scavengers' operation is underway! We need to mine irradiated ore from tunnels filled with deadly radiation, and guard the base camp from ghoul attack. So far we've met the bare minimum for our quota.

The scavengers' operation is underway! We need to mine irradiated ore from tunnels filled with deadly radiation, and guard the base camp from ghoul attack. So far we've gathered more than enough to meet our quota.

A Brotherhood of Steel Initiate is at the Metal Dome with a small team. Maybe I should speak to him and find out why they're so far from home.
I've agreed to help Initiate Pappas and his field team gather data in arena combat against the Rust Eagle combat robots.

I've been called to Point Pleasant to participate in the Mothman Equinox. I should speak with Interpreter Clarence to begin.

In order to begin the ritual of the Mothman Equinox, I must help destroy all of the vines surrounding the ritual pyres in Point Pleasant. I will then be given a task by one of the Observers attending to the pyre.

The vines have all been destroyed, and the Observers have given their instructions. I am to gather albino Radstag blood, hunt down and kill Cultist Prophets, and destroy totems found along the rooftops.
All of the pyres must be lit before the ritual of the Mothman Equinox can begin.
The sky has changed and I feel very odd. However, I am compelled to fight and defend the ritual's pyres from twisted visions of cultists. I must protect the pyres if I hope to receive enlightenment.
The pyres are safe, but we must return to the roof ot the Mothman Museum to welcome the Wise Mothman. I must dance, sing, or perform any sort of emotion to call him to us.
The ritual of the Mothman Equinox has been a success. The Wise Mothman has arrived. I must commune with him to get a glimpse of his wisdom.
A UFO appeared over Appalachia! I need to head to its location and investigate this...
A UFO appeared over Appalachia, and is now beaming down hostile alien forces. We have to fight back!
Killing all those aliens has drawn the ire of an alien lieutenant. According to Homer, taking down the lieutenant should disable the force field on Brainwave Siphon Kappa.
Taking down Lieutenant Kappa disabled the force field on Brainwave Siphon Kappa. We need to destroy it to protect our brainwaves.
We destroyed Brainwave Siphon Kappa, but there are still two more siphons remaining. Let's gather at Siphon Omega for the next assault.
We need to keep taking down aliens to draw the attention of another alien commander.
We've drawn the attention of two alien captains. Taking them down should disable the force field on Brainwave Siphon Omega.
Taking down those alien captains disabled the force field on Brainwave Siphon Omega. Let's destroy it.
We destroyed two brainwave siphons, but there's still one more remaining. Let's gather at Siphon Zeta for the final assault.
We need to keep taking down aliens to draw the attention of another alien commander. This should be the last one.
An alien general is here to defend the final brainwave siphon. Let's take down that general and finish this.
Taking down General Zeta disabled the force field on the final brainwave siphon. Once we destroy it, the aliens will have to retreat.

Moonshiner Ned is almost ready to start the jamboree.
Time to light the fire and get this moonshine jamboree going.
Defend 3 Stills from dangerous creatures, and kill some Gulpers for their venom so I can fill a bathtub and make moonshine. This sounds about right for a jamboree!

I've agreed to help Luca get back his cargo, as well as his pack Brahmin, "Moona Lisa", from the cultist encampment before Blue Ridge finds out what's happened. I've got to head to the camp.

After reaching the camp Luca explained some of the goods were weak homemade explosives that the Cultist Sanctifiers seem to be carrying. Apparently they should be able to blow the doors off the shacks.

Luca managed to detonate the explosives, so I can start grabbing Cargo and loading up Moona Lisa. The Cargo's pretty tricky to carry, so I'll have to move it one at a time. The cultists aren't happy about it.
I've helped load up the Brahmin, but it seems like Luca's explosives angered something from the swamp, and it's not looking like it's going to leave us alone without a fight.
Ogua Death

I helped Luca get all of his cargo back, and survived that strange creature. Luca's heading off to Blue Ridge now that he won't get in trouble. Hopefully he learns to be more discerning with his customers in future.

I've agreed to help Vera and Clyde take back the Blue Ridge Middle Mountain Pitstop from the "Critters" that have overrun it. I have to get rid of the ones roaming around the grounds and cabins.

I've been helping Vera from Blue Ridge take back the Middle Mountain Pitstop. After clearing out the "Critters", they've asked me to get their Repeller speakers working by mending their circuit breakers. Keeps the "Critters" away apparently.

I've been helping Vera from Blue Ridge take back the Middle Mountain Pitstop. After fixing the fuse boxes, the main tower Repeller started to malfunction, causing "Critters" to swarm the Pitstop. I have to protect the Repeller generator until Clyde can fix it.

I've been helping Vera from Blue Ridge take back the Middle Mountain Pitstop. The main Repeller tower let out a pulse that made the "Critters" heads explode! The speakers have stopped for now, so I just have to wait for Clyde to get it working correctly now.

I've assembled a small care package. Now I need to deliver it.
I've delivered my care package to the appropriate party. I should return to Lane and let him know the job's done.

I've collected fresh meat from the first Responders trap. On to the next.
I've collected fresh meat from the second trap. Only one more to go.
I've collected meat from all of the Responders' traps in the forest. Time to return to Lane and hand it over.

I've entered a cave system that is home to Mothman cultists. I should search around for any artifacts that could give the Responders more information on the cult.
I've gotten my hands on some Mothman cultist artifacts. I need to return them to Lane and the Responders so they can learn more about the cult.
I've returned to Lane, and he's pleased with my job well done!
A radio broadcast requesting assistance is coming from a nearby power substation. I should investigate.
A man named David has asked me to help him repair the nearby Lightning Harvester. He is scanning the area to see if there are enough parts for his repairs.
I must find & install Harvester Parts to get the Harvester operational. I should be careful; the parts scan also indicated Lost signatures in the area.
I have found and installed the parts the harvester required. I need to wait while David powers it up.
I must help charge the harvester by killing nearby Charged enemies.

The storm has woken a giant dormant Hermit Crab! It must be destroyed, as its presence is preventing the Harvester from dissipating the storm it created, which will kill the settlers inside the bunker!
I successfully repaired & charged the harvester and eliminated the threat to the tourists!

Beezlebub, the giant murderous honeybeast of yore, is terrorizing the flower meadow. Black-Eyed Susan needs me to kill him.
